name: formula_boolean_case
body:
Range("A1:D4").Clear
Range("A1").Value = "Alpha"
Range("B1").Value = "alphabet"

On Error Resume Next
Range("C3").Formula = "=TRUE()"

n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|"
If Not hit Is Nothing Then Report = Report & hit.Address
